title: Bedrock Anthropic passthrough: Anthropic models only, API-key auth only, client credentials always dropped
answers: Bedrock passthrough returns 501 with access keys or IAM role
Gateway returns 400 for a non-Claude model on the Anthropic messages route
Client Authorization or x-api-key leaks to Bedrock through the gateway
Which Bedrock auth modes support the Anthropic Messages passthrough
body:
Invariant: the Bedrock Anthropic Messages passthrough runs only for Anthropic models on bearer-token (Bedrock API key) auth. Other models get 400; SigV4 modes (access keys, IAM role, default chain) get 501.
Enforced by: mlflow/gateway/providers/bedrock.py:AmazonBedrockProvider._passthrough checks self._underlying_provider against AmazonBedrockModelProvider.ANTHROPIC and self._is_token_auth before any request is built.
Client auth headers are removed by _drop_client_auth_headers (mlflow/gateway/providers/base.py), then host and content-length are removed, then the endpoint's token headers from _get_token_auth_headers are merged last. A credential agent's own key is dropped too.
What breaks if skipped: a client credential reaches Bedrock, which accepts only the endpoint's API key, or a non-Anthropic body is sent to the Anthropic-shaped invoke path.
The 501 uses the same AIGatewayException pattern this provider already uses for unsupported auth modes.
applies: AmazonBedrockProvider passthrough actions only; Boto3 invoke_model for SigV4 is not implemented by this path.
says: The Bedrock Anthropic messages endpoint returns a 501 error when using AWS IAM authentication.
Sending non-Claude models through the Anthropic messages route fails with a 400 error.
Ensure client API keys and authorization headers are never forwarded to the Bedrock service.
Why does Bedrock Anthropic passthrough only support API key authentication instead of AWS credentials?
search: The Bedrock Anthropic Messages passthrough in mlflow/gateway/providers/bedrock.py:AmazonBedrockProvider._passthrough is restricted to AmazonBedrockModelProvider.ANTHROPIC models using bearer-token API key authentication. Other models return 400, while SigV4 authentication modes return 501 via AIGatewayException because Boto3 invoke_model is not implemented on this path. Client authentication headers and credential agent keys are stripped by _drop_client_auth_headers in mlflow/gateway/providers/base.py, host and content-length are removed, and endpoint token headers from _get_token_auth_headers are merged last.
